title: (4,1) with explicit remainder 29*N^(4/5): pair-domain gate elimination (charge 9) on the certificate-prefix BK family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total uniform family defined in proof.md: for input length N, let B be the least positive integer with B^5 > 32 N^3 and k the least prime >= B; if k >= N, output 0. Otherwise read the first k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2 and output 0 unless Q passes the exact irreducibility test of proof.md Section 2. Split the remaining m = N - k bits into r = ceil(m/k) blocks over K = F_2[Z]/(Q) (zero padding, first bit the constant coefficient), put y_i = a_i^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r), t = ceil(sqrt(r)), computed by the division-free recurrence of proof.md. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator computes every length.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"29"},"exponent":{"denominator":"5","numerator":"4"},"log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, for every integer N >= 2^20, C_B2(f_N) >= 4N - 29*N^(4/5) in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length N; in particular liminf over all integer N of C_B2(f_N)/N >= 4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}
